parsed.summary: The PR adds the `store_cv_values` parameter to `RidgeClassifierCV`, which resolves the issue but may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The addition of `store_cv_values` may change the behavior of existing code that relies on the current initialization parameters of `RidgeClassifierCV`. This could lead to unexpected behavior or errors in user code.
